parameters.query:
SELECT a.approval_id,a.proposal_id,a.proposal_revision,a.action_type,a.source_version,a.target_version,
       a.delivery_token::text AS token,a.expires_at,p.reason,p.evidence_refs,i.incident_id,i.service,
       i.environment,i.severity,i.current_version,i.state
FROM ir_approvals a
JOIN ir_proposals p ON p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id
JOIN ir_incidents i ON i.incident_id=p.incident_id
WHERE a.status='PENDING' AND p.status='PROPOSED' AND p.action_type='rollback'
  AND i.state='WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL' AND a.expires_at>NOW()
ORDER BY a.created_at;

const raw=$json.body??$json; const b=typeof raw==='string'?(()=>{try{return JSON.parse(raw)}catch{return {}}})():raw; const errors=[]; if(!b||typeof b!=='object'||Array.isArray(b)) errors.push('body must be an object'); const str=(k,max=240)=>typeof b?.[k]==='string'&&b[k].length>0&&b[k].length<=max; const healthyTargets=new Set(['v1.8.1','v1.8.3']); const supportedReleases=new Set(['v1.8.1','v1.8.2','v1.8.3']); if(!str('approval_id',80))errors.push('approval_id is invalid'); if(!str('proposal_id',80))errors.push('proposal_id is invalid'); if(!Number.isInteger(Number(b?.proposal_revision))||Number(b.proposal_revision)<1)errors.push('proposal_revision is invalid'); if(b?.action_type!=='rollback')errors.push('action_type is unsupported'); if(!str('source_version',80)||!supportedReleases.has(b.source_version)||!str('target_version',80)||!healthyTargets.has(b.target_version)||b.source_version===b.target_version)errors.push('release binding is unsupported'); if(!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(String(b?.token||'')))errors.push('approval token is invalid'); if(!['approve','reject'].includes(b?.decision))errors.push('decision must be approve or reject'); return {json:{valid:errors.length===0,errors,approval:{approval_id:b?.approval_id,proposal_id:b?.proposal_id,proposal_revision:Number(b?.proposal_revision),action_type:b?.action_type,source_version:b?.source_version,target_version:b?.target_version,token:b?.token,decision:b?.decision}}};

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (SELECT $1::text approval_id,$2::text proposal_id,$3::integer proposal_revision,$4::text action_type,$5::text source_version,$6::text target_version,$7::uuid delivery_token,$8::text decision),
expired AS (UPDATE ir_approvals a SET status='EXPIRED',decision='reject',decided_at=NOW(),consumed_at=NOW() FROM request r,ir_proposals p,ir_incidents i WHERE a.approval_id=r.approval_id AND a.proposal_id=r.proposal_id AND a.delivery_token=r.delivery_token AND a.token_hash=encode(digest(r.delivery_token::text,'sha256'),'hex') AND a.status='PENDING' AND a.expires_at<=NOW() AND a.proposal_revision=r.proposal_revision AND a.action_type=r.action_type AND a.source_version=r.source_version AND a.target_version=r.target_version AND p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id AND p.revision=a.proposal_revision AND p.status='PROPOSED' AND i.incident_id=p.incident_id AND i.state='WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL' AND i.revision=p.revision RETURNING a.approval_id,a.proposal_id,p.incident_id),
expired_proposal AS (UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status='EXPIRED' FROM expired e WHERE p.proposal_id=e.proposal_id RETURNING p.proposal_id),
expired_incident AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state='NEEDS_ATTENTION',updated_at=NOW(),summary='Approval expired before a human decision.' FROM expired e WHERE i.incident_id=e.incident_id RETURNING i.incident_id),
consumed AS (UPDATE ir_approvals a SET status=CASE WHEN r.decision='approve' THEN 'CONSUMED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END,decision=r.decision,decided_at=NOW(),consumed_at=NOW() FROM request r,ir_proposals p,ir_incidents i WHERE a.approval_id=r.approval_id AND a.proposal_id=r.proposal_id AND a.delivery_token=r.delivery_token AND a.token_hash=encode(digest(r.delivery_token::text,'sha256'),'hex') AND a.status='PENDING' AND a.expires_at>NOW() AND a.proposal_revision=r.proposal_revision AND a.action_type=r.action_type AND a.source_version=r.source_version AND a.target_version=r.target_version AND p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id AND p.revision=a.proposal_revision AND p.action_type=r.action_type AND p.source_version=r.source_version AND p.target_version=r.target_version AND p.status='PROPOSED' AND i.incident_id=p.incident_id AND i.state='WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL' AND i.revision=p.revision AND (r.decision='reject' OR (i.environment='production-demo' AND i.service='checkout-api' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_remediation_attempts prior WHERE prior.approval_id=a.approval_id))) RETURNING a.approval_id,a.proposal_id,p.incident_id,r.decision,r.proposal_revision,r.source_version,r.target_version),
reserved AS (INSERT INTO ir_remediation_attempts(proposal_id,approval_id,request_id,source_version,target_version,result,error) SELECT c.proposal_id,c.approval_id,'ir-approval-'||c.approval_id||'-'||c.proposal_revision::text,c.source_version,c.target_version,'blocked',NULL FROM consumed c WHERE c.decision='approve' ON CONFLICT(request_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING attempt_id,proposal_id,approval_id,request_id),
updated_proposal AS (UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status=CASE WHEN c.decision='approve' THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END FROM consumed c WHERE p.proposal_id=c.proposal_id AND (c.decision='reject' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) RETURNING p.proposal_id),
updated_incident AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state=CASE WHEN c.decision='approve' THEN 'REMEDIATING' ELSE 'NEEDS_ATTENTION' END,updated_at=NOW(),summary=CASE WHEN c.decision='approve' THEN 'Exact rollback proposal approved by a human; remediation outcome is pending.' ELSE 'Rollback proposal rejected by a human.' END FROM consumed c WHERE i.incident_id=c.incident_id AND (c.decision='reject' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) RETURNING i.incident_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reserved) THEN 'approve' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consumed WHERE decision='reject') THEN 'reject' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expired) THEN 'expired' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM consumed) THEN 'reservation_failed' ELSE 'invalid_or_already_used' END AS result,COALESCE((SELECT approval_id FROM reserved),(SELECT approval_id FROM consumed)) AS approval_id,COALESCE((SELECT proposal_id FROM reserved),(SELECT proposal_id FROM consumed)) AS proposal_id,COALESCE((SELECT incident_id FROM consumed),(SELECT incident_id FROM expired)) AS incident_id,(SELECT attempt_id FROM reserved) AS attempt_id,(SELECT request_id FROM reserved) AS request_id;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json.result; const status=r==='reject'?'rejected':r==='expired'?'expired':'invalid_or_already_used'; return {json:{status,message:status==='rejected'?'Approval rejected; no rollback was performed.':status==='expired'?'Approval expired; no rollback was performed.':'Approval is invalid, stale, expired, or already used; no rollback was performed.'}};

parameters.query:
SELECT a.approval_id,a.proposal_id,a.proposal_revision,a.source_version,a.target_version,
       p.incident_id,ra.attempt_id,ra.request_id
FROM ir_approvals a JOIN ir_proposals p ON p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id
JOIN ir_incidents i ON i.incident_id=p.incident_id AND i.revision=p.revision
JOIN ir_remediation_attempts ra ON ra.approval_id=a.approval_id AND ra.proposal_id=p.proposal_id
 AND ra.request_id='ir-approval-'||a.approval_id||'-'||a.proposal_revision::text
WHERE a.approval_id=$1 AND a.proposal_id=$2 AND a.status='CONSUMED' AND a.decision='approve'
  AND ra.result='blocked' AND ra.completed_at IS NULL AND p.status='APPROVED' AND i.state='REMEDIATING'
  AND i.environment='production-demo' AND i.service='checkout-api';

parameters.jsCode: const r=$('Bind Approved Rollback Request').first().json; const response=$json||{}; const body=response.body&&typeof response.body==='object'?response.body:{}; const current=body.version||'unknown'; const currentValid=Number(response.statusCode)===200&&typeof body.version==='string'; return {json:{...r,current_version:current,stale:currentValid&&current!==r.source_version,precheck_unavailable:!currentValid,precheck_status:Number(response.statusCode||0)}};

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (SELECT $1::text approval_id,$2::text proposal_id,$3::text request_id,$4::text source_version,$5::text target_version,$6::text observed_version),
attempt AS (UPDATE ir_remediation_attempts a SET result='stale',observed_version=r.observed_version,error='Approved source release is no longer current.',completed_at=NOW() FROM request r WHERE a.request_id=r.request_id AND a.approval_id=r.approval_id AND a.proposal_id=r.proposal_id AND a.result='blocked' AND a.completed_at IS NULL RETURNING a.attempt_id,a.proposal_id),
changed AS (UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status='STALE' FROM attempt a WHERE p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id AND p.status='APPROVED' RETURNING p.incident_id,a.attempt_id),
moved AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state='NEEDS_ATTENTION',updated_at=NOW(),summary='REMEDIATION BLOCKED: production changed after the approval proposal.' FROM changed c WHERE i.incident_id=c.incident_id AND i.state='REMEDIATING' RETURNING i.incident_id,c.attempt_id)
SELECT a.attempt_id,(SELECT incident_id FROM moved) AS incident_id,(SELECT source_version FROM request) AS approved_source,(SELECT observed_version FROM request) AS current_version,CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM moved)=1 THEN 'stale_approval_blocked' ELSE 'state_guard_rejected' END AS result FROM attempt a;

parameters.jsCode: return {json:{status:$json.result,message:'REMEDIATION BLOCKED: the approved source release is no longer current. No rollback was sent.',approved_source_version:$json.approved_source,current_version:$json.current_version,reason:$json.result==='state_guard_rejected'?'incident or proposal state changed':'production changed after the proposal'}};

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (SELECT $1::text approval_id,$2::text proposal_id,$3::text request_id,$4::text source_version,$5::text target_version,$6::integer http_status),
attempt AS (UPDATE ir_remediation_attempts a SET result='blocked',http_status=r.http_status,error='Could not verify current release before rollback; no rollback was sent.',completed_at=NOW() FROM request r WHERE a.request_id=r.request_id AND a.approval_id=r.approval_id AND a.proposal_id=r.proposal_id AND a.result='blocked' AND a.completed_at IS NULL RETURNING a.attempt_id,a.proposal_id),
proposal AS (UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status='CANCELLED' FROM attempt a WHERE p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id AND p.status='APPROVED' RETURNING p.incident_id,a.attempt_id),
incident AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state='NEEDS_ATTENTION',updated_at=NOW(),summary='Rollback was blocked because the current release could not be verified.' FROM proposal p WHERE i.incident_id=p.incident_id AND i.state='REMEDIATING' RETURNING i.incident_id,i.state,p.attempt_id)
SELECT a.attempt_id,COALESCE(i.incident_id,(SELECT p.incident_id FROM ir_proposals p WHERE p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id)) AS incident_id,COALESCE(i.state,'NEEDS_ATTENTION') AS incident_state FROM attempt a LEFT JOIN incident i ON i.attempt_id=a.attempt_id;

parameters.jsCode: return {json:{status:'precheck_unavailable',message:'Rollback blocked because the current release could not be verified. No rollback was sent.',attempt_id:$json.attempt_id,incident_id:$json.incident_id}};

const req=$('Compare Actual Release With Approval').first().json; const res=$json||{}; const body=res.body&&typeof res.body==='object'?res.body:{}; const http=Number(res.statusCode||0); const succeeded=http===200&&body.outcome==='succeeded'&&body.source_version===req.source_version&&body.target_version===req.target_version&&body.request_id===req.request_id&&body.version===req.target_version; const stale=http===409&&body.detail?.code==='stale_source_version'; const result=succeeded?'succeeded':stale?'stale':'failed'; return {json:{...req,http_status:http,result,observed_version:succeeded?body.version:stale?(body.detail?.current_version||req.current_version):req.current_version,error:result==='succeeded'?null:stale?'RelayCart rejected a stale source version.':'Rollback request did not return the exact expected result.'}};

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (SELECT $1::text approval_id,$2::text proposal_id,$3::text request_id,$4::text source_version,$5::text target_version,$6::text result,$7::integer http_status,$8::text observed_version,$9::text error),
attempt AS (UPDATE ir_remediation_attempts a SET result=r.result,http_status=r.http_status,observed_version=r.observed_version,response=jsonb_build_object('outcome',r.result,'http_status',r.http_status,'source_version',r.source_version,'target_version',r.target_version,'observed_version',r.observed_version),error=r.error,completed_at=NOW() FROM request r WHERE a.request_id=r.request_id AND a.approval_id=r.approval_id AND a.proposal_id=r.proposal_id AND a.result='blocked' AND a.completed_at IS NULL RETURNING a.attempt_id,a.proposal_id,a.result),
proposal AS (UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status=CASE WHEN a.result='succeeded' THEN 'EXECUTED' WHEN a.result='stale' THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'CANCELLED' END FROM attempt a WHERE p.proposal_id=a.proposal_id AND p.status='APPROVED' RETURNING p.incident_id,a.attempt_id,a.result),
incident AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state=CASE WHEN p.result='succeeded' THEN 'VERIFYING' ELSE 'NEEDS_ATTENTION' END,updated_at=NOW(),summary=CASE WHEN p.result='succeeded' THEN 'Rollback returned success; business recovery verification is pending.' WHEN p.result='stale' THEN 'REMEDIATION BLOCKED: production changed before rollback completed.' ELSE 'Rollback call did not complete successfully; incident needs attention.' END FROM proposal p WHERE i.incident_id=p.incident_id AND i.state='REMEDIATING' RETURNING i.incident_id,i.state,p.attempt_id,p.result)
SELECT a.attempt_id,a.result,COALESCE(i.state,(SELECT ci.state FROM ir_proposals cp JOIN ir_incidents ci ON ci.incident_id=cp.incident_id WHERE cp.proposal_id=a.proposal_id),'STATE_GUARD_REJECTED') AS incident_state,a.proposal_id FROM attempt a LEFT JOIN incident i ON i.attempt_id=a.attempt_id;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json; return {json:{status:r.incident_state==='VERIFYING'?'rollback_succeeded_verification_pending':r.incident_state==='STATE_GUARD_REJECTED'?'state_guard_rejected':r.result,message:r.incident_state==='VERIFYING'?'Rollback succeeded; recovery verification is running.':r.result==='stale'?'REMEDIATION BLOCKED: production changed after approval; no stale rollback occurred.':'Rollback failed; incident needs attention.',attempt_id:r.attempt_id,incident_id:r.incident_id||null}};

const r=$json; return {json:{status:'verification_complete',message:'Rollback response was followed by persisted recovery checks.',attempt_id:r.attempt_id,checks_persisted:r.checks_persisted,recovered:r.state==='RECOVERED',incident_state:r.state}};

parameters.query:
WITH expired AS (UPDATE ir_approvals a SET status='EXPIRED',decision='reject',decided_at=NOW(),consumed_at=NOW() FROM ir_proposals p JOIN ir_incidents i ON i.incident_id=p.incident_id WHERE a.proposal_id=p.proposal_id AND a.status='PENDING' AND a.expires_at<=NOW() AND p.status='PROPOSED' AND i.state='WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL' AND i.revision=p.revision RETURNING a.approval_id,p.proposal_id,p.incident_id),
expired_proposals AS (UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status='EXPIRED' FROM expired e WHERE p.proposal_id=e.proposal_id RETURNING p.proposal_id),
expired_incidents AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state='NEEDS_ATTENTION',updated_at=NOW(),summary='Approval expired without a human decision.' FROM expired e WHERE i.incident_id=e.incident_id RETURNING i.incident_id),
stranded AS (UPDATE ir_remediation_attempts a SET result='blocked',error='n8n did not finalize the rollback response; reconcile current release before proposing another action.',completed_at=NOW() WHERE a.result='blocked' AND a.completed_at IS NULL AND a.started_at<NOW()-interval '2 minutes' RETURNING a.proposal_id,a.attempt_id),
stranded_proposals AS (UPDATE ir_proposals p SET status='CANCELLED' FROM stranded s WHERE p.proposal_id=s.proposal_id AND p.status='APPROVED' RETURNING p.incident_id,s.attempt_id),
stranded_incidents AS (UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state='NEEDS_ATTENTION',updated_at=NOW(),summary='Remediation outcome needs reconciliation; n8n did not record a terminal result.' FROM stranded_proposals s WHERE i.incident_id=s.incident_id AND i.state='REMEDIATING' RETURNING i.incident_id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM expired) AS expired_approvals,(SELECT count(*) FROM expired_proposals) AS proposals_updated,(SELECT count(*) FROM expired_incidents) AS incidents_escalated,(SELECT count(*) FROM stranded) AS stranded_attempts,(SELECT count(*) FROM stranded_incidents) AS stranded_incidents_escalated;
